title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Zaytech Smart…
description: A DOM-based Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Zaytech Smart Online Order for Clover, affecting versions up to 1.6.6. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to execute malicious scripts in users' browsers. The vulnerability is rated high severity with a CVSS score of 7.1.
